summary.text: Sayra DeVito is a Republican state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Rockingham 8 who took office in December 2024 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: DeVito won the Republican primary for Rockingham 8 on September 10, 2024, and then defeated Sheila Johannesen in the general election on November 5, 2024.
She advanced from the Republican primary on September 8, 2026, and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
